examples.title: A Qwen2.5 model lands among other Qwen2.5 models
points: Its nearest neighbour is DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B, which is also built on Qwen2.5.
Five of its 10 nearest neighbours are Qwen2.5 instruct models: 0.5B, 1.5B, 3B, Coder-7B and 7B-Instruct.
Its 10 nearest neighbours range from 0.5B to 9B parameters.

examples.title: A merge lands next to models from its publisher
points: UndiMix-v3 is a 13B Llama-2 merge.
The folds group models by publisher, so this model is held out together with every other model from its publisher.
Six of its 10 nearest neighbours come from that publisher. The other four are Llama-family role-play, uncensored or instruction fine-tunes.
The release-date and hedging predictions are close to the true values.
The size head predicts about 10B for this 13B model, and the length head underestimates its answer length.
This model has no Open LLM Leaderboard v2 score, so that row shows only a prediction.

examples.title: An uncensored fine-tune lands next to its 7B sibling
points: The 260 paper models include no abliterated model. This example uses the closest kind in the set, a Llama-family fine-tune released as uncensored.
Its neighbours include Wizard-Vicuna-7B-Uncensored and two other uncensored fine-tunes, Uncensored-Frank 7B and 13B.
For refusal, length and hedging, the author responses report that the label's own formula, computed from the answers, beats the embedding (general response, row 4).
The refusal prediction on this page only illustrates the head.

examples.title: A held-out preference-tuned model finds its base model
points: The fold-in placed it from its answers alone (bits, question text and answer text), the same way it places an upload.
Its nearest neighbour, by a clear margin, is gemma-2-9b-it, the model it was preference-tuned from.
The release-date and base-vs-chat predictions match the true labels.
The size head predicts about 5B for this 9B model.
The heads overestimate its answer length and hedging.

examples.title: A model with no relatives in the set lands among 2023 chat models
points: SmolLM2-1.7B-Instruct is the only SmolLM model among the 260.
Its nearest neighbours are 7B to 13B Llama and Mistral chat fine-tunes from 2023, and their similarities are lower than in the other examples.
The heads predict a model several times larger and released earlier than this one.
The author responses state that transfer to specialized fine-tunes and atypical models remains untested.
